headline: [Financial Stocks] Hana Financial... Sorry, Taiwan Cooperative Financial (5880) H1 EPS Hits Record 0.8 Yuan; Dividends Mainly in Cash - Finance
summary: Taiwan Cooperative Financial Holding reported first-half consolidated after-tax profit of NT$13.392 billion, up 36.67% year on year. First-half EPS reached a record NT$0.8, with dividends mainly in cash.
why: Taiwan Cooperative Financial is a state-linked financial holding company with banking and insurance operations. Its dividend policy is closely followed by income-focused investors.
